name: cloudflare-gateway
description: Cloudflare AI Gateway — a proxy that adds observability, caching, rate limiting, and fallback to your existing LLM provider API keys. Replace YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID and YOUR_GATEWAY_ID in the model URLs with your Cloudflare account and gateway IDs.
keyInstructions: 1) Create an AI Gateway at https://dash.cloudflare.com > AI > AI Gateway. 2) Copy your Account ID and Gateway ID from the gateway overview. 3) Replace YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID and YOUR_GATEWAY_ID in the model URLs. 4) Use your upstream provider API key (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek) as the API key, or use a Cloudflare API token if you have BYOK / Unified Billing configured.
